def init():
    return dict(busy=0, bit_index=0, count=0, data=0, tx=1, in_ready=1)


def step(state, inputs):
    rst = int(inputs.get("rst", 0))
    in_valid = int(inputs.get("in_valid", 0))
    in_data = int(inputs.get("in_data", 0)) & 255

    if rst:
        state["busy"] = 0
        state["bit_index"] = 0
        state["count"] = 0
        state["data"] = 0
        state["tx"] = 1
        state["in_ready"] = 1
    elif state["busy"]:
        count = state["count"] + 1
        if count >= int(state.get("div", 868)):
            bit_index = state["bit_index"] + 1
            if bit_index >= 10:
                state["busy"] = 0
                state["bit_index"] = 0
                state["count"] = 0
                state["tx"] = 1
                state["in_ready"] = 1
            else:
                state["bit_index"] = bit_index
                state["count"] = 0
                if bit_index == 9:
                    state["tx"] = 1
                else:
                    state["tx"] = (state["data"] >> (bit_index - 1)) & 1
        else:
            state["count"] = count
    elif in_valid and state["in_ready"]:
        div = int(inputs.get("DIV", state.get("div", 868)))
        state["div"] = div
        state["data"] = in_data
        state["busy"] = 1
        state["bit_index"] = 0
        state["count"] = 0
        state["tx"] = 0
        state["in_ready"] = 0

    outputs = dict(in_ready=int(state["in_ready"]), tx=int(state["tx"]))
    return state, outputs
